_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the B crossing watch schedule.
Every table in docs/ that names a time, an owner or a trigger is GENERATED
from this file by scripts/render-crossing-schedule.mjs. Do not hand-edit those
tables — `pnpm check:schedule` fails if they drift from this file.
WHY: on 2026-09-16 four documents restated this schedule and gave three
different answers. Two operational pages said 'Fatih primary, Rakha backup',
which was the inverse of what had been agreed in #104. A summary table and the
sections it summarises drift apart when only one is edited, and the table is
what people read on the day.

checkpoints.note: Declined once as part of the 01:00/07:00 WIB pair, then accepted as a standalone 07:00 WIB morning slot after 01:00 was dropped.
Accepted on first asking. It is the slot that fills the twelve-hour gap running into expiry.

declined.reason: Not for want of a volunteer — it is the wrong place for a checkpoint. It would have made the sequence dense early and left a twelve-hour gap running into expiry, which is the interval a reader actually asks about. The 06:00 UTC slot fills that gap instead, and costs a lunchtime rather than a night.
